# Peoria Epoxy Flooring Experts

## About
Peoria Epoxy Flooring Experts installs professional epoxy floor coatings for garages, basements, and commercial spaces throughout Peoria, IL. We handle everything from surface prep and crack repair to metallic finishes and flake broadcast systems. Free quotes on all projects.

## Services
- Garage Floor Epoxy (solid color, chip/flake, and metallic finishes)
- Basement Floor Coating (moisture-resistant systems for residential basements)
- Commercial Epoxy Flooring (warehouses, showrooms, retail floors, light industrial)
- Metallic Epoxy Floors (decorative metallic finishes for garages and interior spaces)
- Flake Broadcast Epoxy (vinyl chip systems for durability and texture)
- Floor Prep and Repair (crack filling, spall repair, grinding, surface leveling)
- Concrete Coating (clear sealers and polyurea topcoats)

## Service Area
Peoria, Peoria Heights, East Peoria, Dunlap, Chillicothe, Washington, Morton, Bartonville, Metamora, Peoria County, Tazewell County, Woodford County

## Contact

## Why Choose Us
Locally based in Peoria with over ten years coating floors in the area. We do proper surface prep — diamond grinding and moisture testing — before any coating goes down, which is why our floors last where others fail. The work is done by our crew, not a subcontractor.
